items.prompt: Every x value is identical. What happens to the intercept/slope fit?

options.why: It is a sum of nonnegative squared deviations.

options.text: The data identify a unique slope of 1
options.why: Constant predictors cannot identify a unique slope with an intercept.

options.text: Sxx=0; no unique slope is identified
options.why: An intercept-only alternative is a separate declared model.

options.text: Division by zero proves a profitable signal
options.why: A failed fit contract supplies no decision evidence.

items.explanation: The denominator needs positive predictor variation. Rejecting a nonidentified slope is more honest than inventing one.
